newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBJ covered expected loan losses from Koei failure.
newsitem.headline: IBJ covered expected loan losses from Koei failure.

text.p: The Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd said on Tuesday that it had already set aside loan loss provisions on its loans to failed finance firm Koei Corp.

The bank also said in a statement that the effective bankruptcy of the unlisted non-bank finance firm, which sought liquidation on Monday under court protection, would not have any impact on its earnings forecast for 1996/97 ending March 31.
IBJ's outstanding loans to Koei totalled 59.96 billion yen as of Monday, it said.
IBJ currently expects to post a parent current profit of 90 billion yen for 1996/97 against an actual 166.99 billion yen parent current loss in 1995/96.
